content:
Ravi: ISP outage hit my street. wired running through the hallway was cut by a contractor. improvised: fish-taped a new run along the crown molding and hid the faceplate with a faux fern. photo: https://i.imgur.com/fernpatch987.jpg
Sofia: lol the ethernet is thriving in its new habitat. aesthetic win. :fern:
Ben: contractor season is peak drama. did you patch the wall plate or go external?
Ravi: external for now. used low-profile flat cable and painted the clips to match the trim. no drywall surgery tonight.
ops-bot: FYI: If you're doing long cable runs, consider using a surge protector at both ends.
Ivy: question: how's the latency after the reroute?
Ravi: same as before — ping to our staging cluster ~18ms. throughput fine.
Noah: teach me the ways. i've got a 10m gap and a sad wifi extender currently.
Sofia: also protip: label the ends with a tiny tag so you don't pull the wrong cable months later.
Ben: vote: is this "stealth cabling" or "DIY crime scene"? react :one: stealth :two: crime-scene
Ravi: :one: stealth.
Ivy: :one: stealth.
Noah: :two: but i'm biased, i always overcomplicate.
Ravi: thanks for the tips — the contractor left a note so i'll probably upgrade to a flush faceplate next weekend.
Sofia: post a final reveal when you do the faceplate. snacks will be provided for DIY completion.
Ravi: deal. also big thanks to @Ben for lending the fish tape earlier 🙏
Ben: happy to be your cable whisperer.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for downtown fiber on Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. intermittent packet loss possible.
Ravi: perfect, so my new fern fortress gets its first stress test.
Noah: (reacted :thumbsup: to ops-bot)
Sofia: (reacted :heart: to photo)
